name: DeployCat
description: DeployCat is the world's easiest game server manager — 1 paw installs, no claws required. Create, configure, and manage multiple game servers from a single web interface without knocking anything off the table. Supports Minecraft (Java + Bedrock + Modded), plus Steam games like ARK, Rust, Palworld, Satisfactory, CS2, Valheim, V Rising, and 25+ more. Free 3-day trial to sniff around. Then a paid subscription is required. Meow!

paths.name: Data Location
paths.description: Where DeployCat stores ALL data (servers, config, backups, SteamCMD, Java runtimes, logs). This is the only required mount.

paths.name: Second Drive (Optional)
paths.description: Second drive for installing game servers. Useful if your primary drive is small or you want servers on an SSD.

paths.name: Backup Drive (Optional)
paths.description: Another location for backups. DeployCat can write backups here so they survive a drive failure.

paths.name: Host Tailscale Socket
paths.description: If your Unraid host runs Tailscale, map its socket directory here so DeployCat uses the host's daemon instead of spawning a conflicting one. Leave default if unsure. Only needed when host networking is enabled AND the host runs Tailscale.

variables.name: WebUI Port
variables.description: Port for the DeployCat web interface. Access the UI at http://your-ip:PORT.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file ownership. Default 99 (nobody) matches Unraid convention. Run 'id -u' on your host to find yours.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file ownership. Default 100 (users) matches Unraid convention. Run 'id -g' on your host to find yours.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for scheduling (backup schedules, start/stop schedules). Use IANA format e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London. Without this, all schedules run in UTC.

variables.name: Host IP
variables.description: Optional: Your Unraid server's LAN IP. Shown in DeployCat so you know what IP players use to connect. Auto-detected if not set.

variables.name: TS_SOCKET
variables.description: Path to the host's Tailscale daemon socket. Only used when Host Tailscale Socket is mapped. This lets DeployCat control the host's Tailscale (auth, status, connect) without running a duplicate daemon.
